examples.japanese: {豪華|ごうか}な{食事|しょくじ}
{豪華|ごうか}{客船|きゃくせん}
{結婚式|けっこんしき}は{豪華|ごうか}な{会場|かいじょう}で{行|おこな}われ、{多|おお}くの{著名人|ちょめいじん}が{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: The wedding was held at a luxurious venue, attended by many celebrities.

notes:
{豪華|ごうか} is a na-adjective describing something impressively luxurious, lavish, or gorgeous. It emphasizes visual splendor and high quality rather than mere expense.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {豪華|ごうか}な (e.g., {豪華|ごうか}なホテル)
- Adverbial: {豪華|ごうか}に (e.g., {豪華|ごうか}に{飾|かざ}る)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪華|ごうか}なホテル: luxury hotel
- {豪華|ごうか}な{料理|りょうり}: lavish cuisine
- {豪華|ごうか}{客船|きゃくせん}: luxury cruise liner
- {豪華|ごうか}{絢爛|けんらん}: gorgeous and dazzling (four-character idiom)
- {豪華|ごうか}キャスト: star-studded cast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}: extravagant, wastefully lavish (can be negative)
- {華麗|かれい}: splendid, magnificent (more literary)
- {豪華|ごうか} is always positive, emphasizing grandeur and impressiveness
